core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mohd is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Praised, commendable”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mohd corresponds to the Arabic form محمد (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad)). Its core sense is praised, commendable. Mohd is a common abbreviated spelling of Arabic مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad) 'praised, commendable', from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d). The source gloss 'Mohammad' is consistent. Same name as mohammad and mohammed.

etymology.morphology: Built on the root ح م د.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form محمد is an established Arabic lexical item, and Mohd is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

language_notes.primary: Arabic is the language of the recorded form محمد.
language_notes.usage: Other scripts are transliterations of the name into those writing systems; they are not independent origins.

origin.origin_explanation: The name originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming through established multilingual use.

religion.religious_status: Culturally used; not inherently a doctrinal term
religion.religious_explanation: Mohd is used by Muslims as a personal name, but the word itself is lexical in origin; its Islamic association is cultural rather than scriptural.

quranic_status.note: Mohd is a Qur'anic name: it is the name of the Prophet of Islam, mentioned in the Qur'an.

hadith_status.note: No specific authentic hadith report about this name is cited; none is invented.

prophetic_status.note: Mohd is the name of the Prophet of Islam, so it is used with prophetic association.

companion_status.note: No companion (sahabi) of this name is attested in this record.

islamic_naming_context.context: Muslim naming culture in South Asia and the Persianate world
islamic_naming_context.interpretation: Its lexical sense is a positive quality that families may wish for a child.
islamic_naming_context.important_distinction: Muslim use of the name is not evidence that the word is Qur'anic or religiously prescribed.

cultural_context.cultural_meaning: In the communities that use it, the name reads as a positive quality.
cultural_context.personal_name_interpretation: As a personal name it can be read as a wish for the quality it names.
cultural_context.interpretation_warning: The symbolic reading is a cultural convention, distinct from the dictionary sense.

spiritual_meaning.meaning: Families may read the sense “Praised, commendable” as a hopeful quality for the child.

personality_associations.note: No verified basis links this name to specific personality traits.

numerology.meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohd total 4, associated with stability, discipline and order. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

urdu.name: محمد
urdu.long_meaning: Mohd (محمد) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم محمد، تعریف شدہ، ستودہ ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: محمد
persian.long_meaning: Mohd (محمد) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن محمد، ستوده، پسندیده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मुहम्मद
hindi.long_meaning: Mohd (मुहम्मद) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ मुहम्मद, प्रशंसित है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: محمد
pashto.long_meaning: Mohd (محمد) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې محمد، ستایل شوی ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: محمد
arabic.long_meaning: Mohd (محمد) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي مُحَمَّد، الْمَحْمُود، الْحَمِيد. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.q: Is Mohd a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Mohd as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
